title: Current QUIC baseline
summary: The current development source is ooRexx QUIC Socket Provider v0.1-dev4. Dev4 adds nonblocking stream creation under QUIC stream-count flow control and local stream allowance observation. Dev3 remains the last live-qualified baseline.
invariants: Development delivery is oorexx_quic_socket_provider_v0.1-dev4.zip with SHA-256 51464ddea2dec56557a8ea7f806fe8f54933da99527b249a67da2e74f3fde63b.
The last live-qualified baseline remains oorexx_quic_socket_provider_v0.1-dev3.zip with SHA-256 34a224252f33079cdbe78d4e5f6f122c0cdd6524364f92e95da36bc233b54749.
Dev4 must not be described as live-qualified until the ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196/native environment suite is rerun.
QUIC remains a sibling provider and is not folded into the common SocketProvider implementation.
